| # bds_out_aov_getVoltage {#bds_out_aov_getvoltage-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Provides voltage of an analog voltage output.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- The voltage range depends on the type.

oAOV: 0 to 12000mV

oPWM: 0 to 33000mV.

- The read-back path of the voltage can also be used as analog input if the set point is set to zero. ( see also [bds_out_aov](bds_out_aov.html){.topiclink}. )\
Diagnostics capabilities similar to standard inputs is not available.

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   For the predefined type AOV is also a reconfiguration with the eC tool as analog voltage input or digital input possible.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  This API can be used in trusted partitions. For untrusted partitions use bds_out_aov_getVoltage_ffi. See [Freedom from Interference (FFI) concept](freedom-from-interference.html){.topiclink} for more details.
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
